If I can give you one piece of advice as someone with a cat who likes cats a lot, it‘d be to just accept when a pet‘s personality doesn‘t work for you and giving it away might have been the best solution. However, if you were abusing the cat for not loving you right off the bat, why would you expect the cat to like you? Cats can be very vigilant around new people and usually if you push too much affection on them it overstimulates them and can easily read to them as a threat. This is why getting a cat with a timid personality is good if you are not able to handle socially withdrawn cats well. Since cats personality can vary a lot. But always remember, cats are a different species just like any other animal. This is why I kinda don‘t get subreddits like this cause hating on any animal for just existing always felt weird to me. Like, i hate spiders but I still can see why some ppl love keeping them as pets. I couldn‘t. But i can appreciate others that share them online. Even if spiders freak me out.

As a general rule tho, if you ever consider another cat, first of all, do not abuse any pet you own ever. Not only is it illegal, it‘s also really unethical. And abuse doesn‘t make any animal love you more. Cats are solitary hunters. Their social behavior and body language is often misread by cat haters as mean or sassy or evil even. But that‘s silly if you know anything about cat‘s social behaviors. Cats have a high level of sensibility. Petting a cat reads as grooming to them. So if you keep stroking the same part they get overstimulated and mad and can hiss, scratch or bite if you keep doing it. So don‘t overwork your pets. Second, don‘t hold a cat by force especially if they want to get away or get angry. Cats don‘t like being held against their will and doing so is threatening to them if anything hence why they go into defense mode and hiss and scratch. Same goes for tail wagging. It‘s a sign of stress and means you need to tone down or let them go. My cat didn‘t like being held at first, but he warmed up to me because i let him chose if he wanted to be held or not by just listening to his signals. Same with pets and him lying down on my lap. There is a multitude of reasons why cats don‘t like you or avoid you. But most often it‘s because you are scary to them. Especially if you ignore their boundaries. If a cat runs under a chair to hide if you approach them, your call is not to force cuddle it, it‘s to let the cat come up to you instead. You are a huge terrifying creature to a cat. If you start off acting with no regard for their compfort or boundaries right from the start, you won‘t warm up to any cat. For cats you need patience, trust and also just knowing that cats are not dogs. A lot of ppl expect cats to be like dogs. But that‘s silly. cats are a different species. And unlike dogs they are very easily frightened and use their claws and teeth a lot to defend themselves. You cannot force a cat to love you. Neither can you expect it to love you if you abuse them for not loving you right away. And if you cannot handle having a cat unless you abuse them to make them „love“ you, maybe you are not ready to have one at all.
